scaleLines.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: Tulsi (Holy Basil). The courtyard herb — tea for coughs. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Night Court is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
📺 Marcus killed Night Court out past the ridge — alone — and walked home. 3 rounds, 9 taken. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 Marcus killed Night Court out past the ridge — alone — and walked home. 3 rounds, 9 taken.

🔥 The fire settles. Marcus has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Night Court — I put it down today." "No sound. That is the warning. The moon-shadow on the ground is growing — and there is no sound at all. Owls don't make sound when they hunt." "It missed — and it is already turning. The second dive re-aims at where you moved." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at

Nora leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Night Court. Dodge twice. No sound is the tell — watch the ground-shadow. A missed dive comes again instantly at your NEW position: dodge TWICE. Then it's exhausted, and the sky is yours."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Night Court: Dodge twice. No sound is the tell — watch the ground-shadow. A missed dive comes again instantly at your NEW position: dodge TWICE. Then it's exhausted, and the sky is yours. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

🧳 Word of Haven’s the televised games, new bindings is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: The Hungry Road and Emberhold have bound together — The Hungry Road primary. Other fires are climbing, too.

🧳 The trader lowers their voice. "And further still — FOUR fires under one head. They call it a REALM. Tribute flows uphill like a river; I saw the grain carts with my own eyes." They won't say more. Or can't.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
